title: Rainbow Enderman Stockings
body:
# 🏳️‍🌈 Pride Enderman Stockings

Tired of the plain black Enderman? Give him some **pride and color**!  

This resource pack adds cute and vibrant **Pride rainbow stockings** to the Enderman’s legs **and arms**!  

Now every Enderman rocks the classic Pride flag colors as stylish socks on his long legs and matching arm sleeves — because even scary teleporting mobs can show their pride 🌈

### Features:
- Full custom textures for Enderman legs and arms with rainbow Pride stripes
- Bright, high-contrast Pride flag colors (classic 6-stripe rainbow)
- Works with normal Endermen in any dimension (Overworld, Nether, The End)
- Compatible with most other resource packs (only overwrites Enderman limb textures)
- Supports Minecraft 1.14 and above

**Pride is about love, acceptance, and vibrant colors!**  
Even Endermen can wear their colors with pride — now with matching stockings and arm sleeves! 🌈

---

**Installation:**  
Just drop the zip file into your `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in the game settings.

Want more Pride flags, different colors, or extra sparkles? Leave a comment — I’ll happily update it!
